text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, you guys are next~.
Hang on tight to my arms, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha! Sooo faaast!!
My heeead is spinniiing!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All dooone!
So, did you have fun?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
That was super, super fun!
Big sis, your arm swing is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, seeing everyone so happy makes Big Sis so molto buono~!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
You know, can I invite my friends and big brother too?
I want us all to walk around together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, leave it to me~!
I'll spin all of you around together~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono gets so caught up in playing
with the children that she completely forgets about training.
